summary: Completed comprehensive frontend-only testing of coliberalai landing page. critical_code_review_comments: CALENDLY_URL and DEMO_AUDIO_URL are hardcoded in /app/frontend/src/lib/constants.js — acceptable since noted as placeholders, but consider moving to env for easier swap.
External audio URL (soundhelix.com) may be blocked by strict CSP/ad-blockers in some networks; consider self-hosting the demo asset.
Hero stats card (38%, 0 missed calls) uses pilot data phrasing — ensure it is factual before production or label as illustrative.
